set.cli.notloggedin.help: Press Sign in. The app shows a link; sign in in your browser, paste the code back here and press Verify.
set.cli.notloggedin.help.codex: Press Sign in. The app shows a one-time code and a link; open the link, enter the code and wait here until it says Signed in.
set.cli.notloggedin.help.agy: Open a terminal, run agy and follow its sign-in steps. Then come back and press Re-check.
set.install.copyopen: Copy command and open install page
set.install.confirm.title: Install this program?
set.install.confirm.body: This will download a program from the internet and run it on this computer. It will run exactly this command, nothing else:
set.install.running: Installing. This can take a few minutes.
set.install.err.failed: The installation failed. The last lines of its output are below. You can also copy the command and run it in a terminal.
set.install.err.timeout: The installation took too long and was stopped.
set.install.err.spawn: The installer could not be started. Copy the command and run it in a terminal instead.
set.install.err.unknown: The installation could not be done from the app. Copy the command and run it in a terminal instead.
set.install.nonpm: npm was not found, so the app cannot install this for you. Install Node.js (nodejs.org) first, or copy the command and run it yourself.
set.install.notfound: The installer finished, but the program was not found yet. Restart the app, or set its path under Advanced, then press Re-check.
set.install.copied: Command copied and the install page opened in your browser:
set.install.copyfail: Could not copy automatically. Select this command and copy it by hand:
set.install.openfail: Could not open the browser. Open this page yourself: {url}
